title: Trust, transparency, privacy and reliability
definition: The product tells the truth about its state, data, limits and failures, collects and shows only what it needs, and behaves predictably, so a user can rely on it and can see why it did what it did.
intended_outcome: Users are not surprised by what the product knows, does or claims, and can recover from a failure with clear information.
implementation_guidance: Honest states: every data-dependent view renders distinct loading, empty, partial, stale and error states with a plain-language cause and next step. Never show success before the server confirms it.
Show source and freshness for derived figures, and label estimates and machine-generated content as such.
Navigation and marketing show only what works today. An unfinished feature is absent, not teased.
Data minimisation: each collected field has a stated purpose at the point of collection; no personal data in URLs or logs; visibility is enforced server-side, not by hiding UI.
No invented proof: counts, testimonials, certifications and partner logos appear only when sourced from real data. Encode the rule in the profile claims_policy.
Every error offers a retry, an undo, an alternative or a named human route. Destructive actions are reversible or confirm with the consequence stated.

automated: Component or route tests assert that each data view renders loading, empty and error states.
Static scan of templates for hard-coded numeric claims and testimonial markup, as a finding list for human review.
Security and privacy tests belong to the product; the engine records pass or fail.
expert_review: Honesty audit: trace every claim on a screen to data or remove it.
observed_behaviour: Incident and error-rate history from product telemetry where it exists.

limitations: Trust is earned by reliability over time. A repository snapshot shows mechanisms and intent, not earned trust.
Privacy compliance is a legal question. This principle does not certify compliance with any law.

evidence.summary: Dot Intelligence Manifesto principle 2: every improvement is explainable; if a human cannot understand why, it does not ship.
Honest states and sourced figures reduce support load and unwarranted reliance.
evidence.rationale: Plausible from general operational experience; not measured as a user effect on Dot products.
